package.name: Memory Nag
package.description: Remembers loose ends from your roleplay, like promises and open questions, and reminds the AI when they matter. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Tracker Agents for Roleplay mode. Once active, configure it in its standalone Memory Nag section.
